updates.canonical_owner: Existing PropertyFoundationMesh::volume_cubic_metres complete native measurement kernel and admitted prism contract; preserve valid finite geometry ratherthan adding unrelated gameplaybounds or a duplicate schema owner.
updates.disposition: volume_cubic_metres promotes plan coordinates before area differences but computes each vertical span as f64::from(f32 top - f32 bottom). The unnecessary f32 intermediate can overflow for opposite-sign finite endpoints even when the represented f64 volume is finite. This is source corroboration of the existing volume-arithmetic item; exact prism admission and actual supported operand/caller/current contracts remain required before a reachable failure or completed repair claim. Preserve ordinary volume precision, structural geometry and separate zero-area/native collider policies.
